assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The service is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The patient has symptoms of palpitations and dizziness.
The patient has a documented diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
